title: NoBreakMod (NBM)
description: Adds the ability to make certain blocks indestructible
body:
# NoBreakMod (NBM)

**NoBreakMod** is a powerful server-side and client-side utility designed for advanced region protection and custom security blocks. It allows authorized players to secure individual blocks, turning them into completely indestructible structures with a vibrant, neon-animated rainbow overlay!

## ⚙️ Features
* **Indestructible Structures:** Protected blocks cannot be broken by any survival/adventure tools, and are 100% immune to all types of explosions (TNT, Respawn Anchors, Beds, or End Crystals).
* **Modern Selection Tool:** Use the custom neon-colored **Selection Wand** crystal (available right after the Netherite Pickaxe in the creative tools tab) to toggle blocks in your selection with *Shift + Right Click*.
* **Dynamic Rainbow Overlay:** Fully animated, glowing neon faces seamlessly render on top of selected blocks, perfectly synchronized across all connected clients via custom network packets.
* **Persistent NBT Data Storage:** Secured positions and the player whitelist are automatically saved directly into the world's save directory, remaining bulletproof across server reboots.

## 💻 Console Commands
* `/brlist add <player>` / `/brlist del <player>` — Manages the list of authorized members (OP required).
* `/no_break` — Locks all currently highlighted blocks, granting them absolute bedrock-level protection (Requires being in the brlist).
* `/non_break` — Removes protection from selected blocks and clears the active wand selection buffer.
